office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes and other county revenue, pays county warrants, and manages the county's investments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: interim Treasurer Carrie Heston (States No Party Preference), appointed in July after Darryl Pheasant retired, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Interim Grant County Treasurer since July 2026 after 28 years in the treasurer's office, most recently as its investment and accounting officer; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed interim treasurer effective July 1, 2026; endorsed by retiring Treasurer Darryl Pheasant [S3]
28 years in the treasurer's office, most recently as investment and accounting officer [S3]
Pledges conservative financial practices, responsible debt management, and stronger fraud-prevention and cybersecurity safeguards [S1]
